name: mcp-server-things
description: Model Context Protocol server for Things 3 task management integration
long_description: This extension provides comprehensive task management capabilities through the Things 3 app via AppleScript. It allows you to view, create, update, and search todos, projects, areas, and tags, including checklist support and bulk operations.

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL

ai_can_create_tags.title: Allow AI to Create Tags
ai_can_create_tags.description: When enabled, the AI assistant may create new Things 3 tags as needed. When disabled, only existing tags can be used.

applescript_timeout.title: AppleScript Timeout (seconds)
applescript_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for AppleScript operations against Things 3 (1-300)

tag_validation_case_sensitive.title: Case-Sensitive Tag Validation
tag_validation_case_sensitive.description: When enabled, tag names like "Work" and "work" are treated as different tags

max_tags_per_item.title: Max Tags Per Item
max_tags_per_item.description: Maximum number of tags allowed on a single todo or project (1-50)

tools.name: add_area

tools.name: add_checklist_items

tools.name: add_project
tools.description: Create a new project.

tools.name: add_tags

tools.name: add_todo
tools.description: Create a new todo.

tools.name: get_recent

tools.name: get_upcoming
